title: A team member cannot access MainHub
summary: A short diagnostic route for distinguishing account, session and permission problems before escalating a systems issue.
contentNotice: Demonstration playbook for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy and must be reviewed before operational use.
scenario: Use this when an internal user cannot sign in to MainHub, can sign in but cannot reach an expected area, or sees an access state that differs from their role.
immediateAction: Confirm whether the failure is sign-in, session, device/browser or permission-specific.
Ask the user to capture the exact visible error/state without sharing passwords or authentication codes.
Check whether the issue occurs in a clean session or another supported browser before treating it as a permissions change.

whoToInform.when: After the basic state is identified.
A role/permission change is actually required or sensitive access is involved.

whatToRecord: Visible error text or screenshot location
escalationConditions: The user appears to have access they should not have.
A required role/permission mapping is missing or unexpectedly changed.
